algorithm.scope: Complete Q1 and Q2 for all primes through N
algorithm.assumptions: Fast integer multiplication/division and polynomial multiplication/power-series inversion; all costs are bit operations.
algorithm.wide_column_arithmetic: GMP product/remainder trees with cached word remainders for small nodes

machine: Apple M1 Max, eight outer workers

completed_one_million_runs.simd_comparator: Prior carry32 NEON kernel, distinct from the later inverse-grouped backend
completed_one_million_runs.timing_excludes: Compilation, independent validation and result serialization

practical_assessment.scope: Implementation-level assessment for the intended p < 2^32 range
practical_assessment.conclusion: Preprocessing, polynomial transforms, memory traffic and multiprecision product/remainder-tree costs make this implementation impractical as an acceleration of the SIMD search.
